articles.title: Nigerian president signs order on approach to crypto regulation, taxes
articles.snippet: The West African country’s executive order established a virtual asset council and addressed the fragmentation of crypto regulation for oversight and enforcement.

articles.title: South Korea probed 40 cases of crypto manipulation over 2 years
articles.snippet: Financial Services Commission Chair Lee Eog-won posted the figures on the second anniversary of the enactment of the Virtual Asset User Protection Act.

articles.title: Upbit parent Dunamu faces South Korean regulator sanctions process: Report
articles.snippet: Korea’s Virtual Asset User Protection Act lacks explicit sanctions provisions for hacking and similar incidents, clouding the scope of penalties facing the Upbit operator Dunamu.
